state.legacy: Android Java app with Home (hero image + 3-column grid of 6 rounded cards, each card has an icon letter and a name) and Read (full-screen PhotoView zoomable image). Content entries are placeholders: icons I,A,B,T,G,R and names SATU,DUA,TIGA,EMPAT,LIMA,ENAM; each entry opens one of 3 photos.

decisions_already_made.reader_zoom: custom ZoomableImage using only core Animated + PanResponder (Jev 0.87)

environment.io_s_build: not possible on Linux, ios folder still part of the deliverable

state.goal: modular feature-based React Native codebase with android and ios, runs on emulator, faithful to the legacy UI, ready for content to be added later
state.team: boss-worker agents with disjoint file scopes

content_model.instructions: How should the catalog and reader content be modeled now, given the legacy app is image-page based and content is not written yet?

criteria.image_pages: Keep image-page reader: catalog entries map to reader images exactly like the legacy app, typed catalog module is the single source of truth
criteria.text_pages: Replace images with text syair pages and typography, dropping the image viewer
criteria.hybrid: Catalog entries carry both an image page and optional text, reader shows whichever is present

catalog_labels.instructions: What labels should the six catalog entries use in the migrated app?

criteria.keep_legacy: Keep legacy placeholders (icons I,A,B,T,G,R and names SATU..ENAM) for exact behavioral fidelity, easy to replace later
criteria.meaningful_titles: Invent meaningful maulid/syair section names while keeping the layout
criteria.hybrid_labels: Keep the icon letters but give descriptive section names

grid_impl.instructions: How should the 3-column catalog grid be implemented in React Native?

criteria.flatlist_num_columns: FlatList with numColumns=3, ListHeaderComponent for the hero, and columnWrapperStyle
criteria.flexwrap_scrollview: ScrollView with flexWrap row of fixed-width items

state_management.instructions: What state management, if any, should the app use for this two-screen catalog app?

criteria.none_local: No global state library: catalog is static data, reader gets its item via route params, local component state only

testing.instructions: What test depth is appropriate for this migration deliverable?

criteria.unit_plus_smoke: Jest + React Native Testing Library: catalog integrity, card rendering and navigation smoke test, no native build tests
criteria.minimal_smoke: One Jest smoke test that App renders
criteria.no_tests: No tests, rely on emulator verification only

folder_layout.instructions: Which folder organization best expresses the requested modular feature-based architecture for React Native, with shared theme/ui, and why?

criteria.feature_first: src/app (root), src/navigation, src/features/home and src/features/reader each with screens/components/data, src/shared/{theme,ui,assets,types}

ios_scope.instructions: Given iOS cannot be built on this Linux machine, the ios folder should still be created and configured for the migration deliverable.
